_comment: Flavor text templates for the Math Quest game, keyed by Concept.category then theme. {name} interpolates the concept's name. Used by backend/app/routers/quest.py. Two themes: 'mystery' (detective) and 'treasure' (explorer).

mystery.intro: A torn page from the case file mentions {name}. Before anything else adds up, you need to understand what it means.
mystery.hint: Every case starts with the basics. Re-read the definition of {name} — the culprit is hiding in plain sight.
mystery.success: The fog clears. {name} was the first solid fact in this case — everything else builds on it.

treasure.intro: The map's border is worn, but one symbol survives: {name}. Nothing else on the map will make sense until you decode it.
treasure.hint: Foundations first — go back to what {name} actually means before chasing the next landmark.
treasure.success: The compass steadies. {name} was bedrock — you can build the rest of the route on it.

mystery.intro: The ledger at the scene is full of numbers involving {name}. The victim was counting something — and it matters.
mystery.hint: Go back to the arithmetic. {name} is just counting and combining, done carefully — don't overthink it.
mystery.success: The numbers finally balance. {name} checks out, and the ledger stops lying.

treasure.intro: An old merchant's tally, half-erased, still shows {name}. Whoever buried the treasure counted their steps this way.
treasure.hint: Count it out slowly — {name} is arithmetic, not sorcery. One step at a time.
treasure.success: The tally adds up. {name} gets you one stride closer to the treasure.

mystery.intro: A cipher at the scene only makes sense once you understand {name} — numbers hiding a message.
mystery.hint: Numbers have secret structure. Think about what {name} reveals about how numbers relate to each other.
mystery.success: The cipher breaks. {name} was the key hiding inside the numbers all along.

treasure.intro: The treasure's lock is a number puzzle built on {name} — no key, just arithmetic cunning.
treasure.hint: The lock rewards patience with numbers. Recall what {name} says about how they behave.
treasure.success: The tumblers click into place. {name} was exactly the trick the locksmith used.

mystery.intro: Witnesses gave contradictory statements — you'll need {name} to represent what's unknown and solve for it.
mystery.hint: Name the unknown, write down what you know, and let {name} do the work of untangling it.
mystery.success: The unknown has a value now. {name} turned a tangle of statements into a single, provable fact.

treasure.intro: A riddle carved in stone hides the treasure's distance behind a variable — solved only by {name}.
treasure.hint: Let x be the unknown distance. {name} is exactly the tool for isolating it.
treasure.success: The riddle resolves to a number. {name} pointed straight at the spot.

mystery.intro: The crime scene's floor plan is oddly shaped — {name} explains why the angles don't lie.
mystery.hint: Look at the shapes, not the story. {name} is about how lines and angles constrain each other.
mystery.success: The floor plan finally makes sense. {name} showed you the one shape that couldn't have happened by accident.

treasure.intro: The old map marks a shape in the terrain — {name} is the only way to read what it's pointing at.
treasure.hint: Trust the shapes on the ground. {name} tells you how they constrain the true path.
treasure.success: The shape resolves into a direction. {name} was the surveyor's real secret.

mystery.intro: The witness statements don't agree, but they cluster — {name} is how you read the truth out of scattered testimony.
mystery.hint: Don't trust any single data point. {name} is about what the whole scatter of evidence is really telling you.
mystery.success: The pattern in the noise finally holds up. {name} turned scattered testimony into a real conclusion.

treasure.intro: A hundred old expedition logs disagree on the route, but their scatter isn't random — {name} finds the signal in it.
treasure.hint: One log could be wrong. All of them together, read with {name}, rarely are.
treasure.success: The logs agree once you look at them the right way. {name} was how you found the real route inside the noise.

mystery.intro: A witness saw the getaway from an angle — {name} is how you turn that angle into a distance.
mystery.hint: Angles and sides are linked. Recall what {name} says about that relationship.
mystery.success: The angle gives up its distance. {name} placed the culprit exactly where the evidence needed them.

treasure.intro: The map gives only an angle of sight to a distant peak — {name} turns that angle into steps.
treasure.hint: An angle alone isn't a distance — not until you apply {name}.
treasure.success: The peak's true distance is yours. {name} turned a sightline into a route.

mystery.intro: Something in this case is changing — a rate, a trajectory — and only {name} explains how fast.
mystery.hint: Don't look at the total, look at the rate of change. That's exactly what {name} measures.
mystery.success: The rate of change confirms it. {name} was the motion no one else noticed.

treasure.intro: The tide is rising over the buried chest, and {name} is the only way to know how fast you're running out of time.
treasure.hint: Think in terms of change over an instant — that's the heart of {name}.
treasure.success: You've outpaced the tide. {name} told you exactly how fast the ground was shifting.

mystery.intro: There are several suspects and only partial evidence — {name} tells you who's really most likely guilty.
mystery.hint: Don't guess — weigh the evidence properly. That's what {name} is for.
mystery.success: The likeliest explanation wins out. {name} turned uncertainty into a real verdict.

treasure.intro: Three paths lead from the fork, and only {name} tells you which is worth the risk.
treasure.hint: Every path has odds. {name} is how you weigh them honestly.
treasure.success: The odds favor you now. {name} picked the path most likely to pay off.

mystery.intro: The suspects' alibis form a web of dependencies — {name} untangles which ones actually hold up together.
mystery.hint: Think of the statements as a system, not one at a time. {name} handles them all at once.
mystery.success: The whole system resolves cleanly. {name} showed exactly how the pieces depended on each other.

treasure.intro: The map's directions only make sense together, as a system — {name} is how you solve them all at once.
treasure.hint: Stop reading one direction at a time. {name} lets you solve the whole system together.
treasure.success: The directions align. {name} solved the whole system in one clean move.

mystery.intro: The suspects can only be arranged so many ways — {name} counts exactly how many, and rules most of them out.
mystery.hint: This is a counting problem, not a guessing game. {name} counts the possibilities exactly.
mystery.success: The possibilities collapse to one. {name} counted precisely enough to name the culprit.

treasure.intro: The vault has a combination with a huge number of possibilities — {name} narrows it down fast.
treasure.hint: Don't try every combination — count the structure of them instead, using {name}.
treasure.success: The combination count clicks into place. {name} made the impossible search small enough to finish.

mystery.intro: A recording from the scene is garbled — {name} is how you separate the message from the noise.
mystery.hint: There's a signal buried in the noise. {name} is exactly the tool for pulling it out.
mystery.success: The recording clears up. {name} separated the real message from everything drowning it out.

treasure.intro: An old recorded chant marks the treasure's location, but it's full of static — {name} filters it clean.
treasure.hint: The chant is a signal, the static is noise — {name} tells them apart.
treasure.success: The chant comes through clearly now. {name} was the filter you needed.

mystery.intro: A melody left at the scene isn't just music — {name} shows the mathematical pattern hidden in it.
mystery.hint: Listen to the structure, not just the notes. {name} is the math underneath the melody.
mystery.success: The melody's pattern gives up its secret. {name} was the code hidden in the music.

treasure.intro: A set of bells marks the trail, each tuned to a ratio described by {name}.
treasure.hint: The bells aren't random — their tuning follows {name}. Listen for the pattern.
treasure.success: The bells ring true. {name} was the tuning that marked the real trail.

mystery.intro: A pattern-recognition device at the scene used {name} to flag its suspect — you need to understand how it decided.
mystery.hint: The device isn't magic — it's math. {name} is exactly how it's weighing the evidence.
mystery.success: You understand the device's reasoning now. {name} was the mechanism behind its verdict.

treasure.intro: An old mechanical oracle points toward the treasure using {name} — but only if you feed it the right question.
treasure.hint: The oracle runs on {name}, not magic. Understand the mechanism and it will answer honestly.
treasure.success: The oracle points true. {name} was the mechanism turning your question into a direction.

mystery.intro: The case's final thread requires {name} — the kind of reasoning that ties every earlier clue together.
mystery.hint: This won't yield to a quick guess. Sit with {name} and let the earlier clues connect.
mystery.success: The final thread pulls tight. {name} was the reasoning that closed the case.

treasure.intro: The last leg of the journey is guarded by {name} — a puzzle built from everything the map taught you so far.
treasure.hint: This is the hardest stretch. {name} rewards everything you've already learned on this journey.
treasure.success: The final guard yields. {name} was the last thing standing between you and the treasure.

mystery.intro: A real device from the scene only makes sense once you see {name} at work inside it.
mystery.hint: This isn't abstract — {name} is doing real work inside a real object. Think practically.
mystery.success: The device's purpose is clear now. {name} was the practical idea making it run.

treasure.intro: A working contraption guards the treasure, built entirely on {name}.
treasure.hint: The contraption is practical, not theoretical — {name} is the working idea behind it.
treasure.success: The contraption powers down safely. {name} was the practical trick behind its design.

0.mystery: Chapter 1: The First Clue — every case starts with a single, undeniable fact.
0.treasure: Chapter 1: The Trailhead — every journey starts from solid ground.

1.mystery: Chapter 2: Following the Numbers — the ledger doesn't lie, if you read it right.
1.treasure: Chapter 2: Counting Your Steps — the first landmarks are close together.

2.mystery: Chapter 3: Shapes and Angles — the scene itself starts to tell its own story.
2.treasure: Chapter 3: Reading the Terrain — the map's shapes start to mean something.

3.mystery: Chapter 4: The Unknowns — it's time to name what you don't yet know, and solve for it.
3.treasure: Chapter 4: The Riddles — the path forward is hidden behind a puzzle.

4.mystery: Chapter 5: Motion and Change — nothing in this case is standing still anymore.
4.treasure: Chapter 5: The Shifting Ground — the terrain itself starts working against you.

5.mystery: Chapter 6: Weighing the Evidence — probability, systems, and structure collide.
5.treasure: Chapter 6: The Guarded Pass — only careful reasoning gets you through.

6.mystery: Chapter 7: The Final Reckoning — every earlier clue was leading here.
6.treasure: Chapter 7: X Marks the Spot — every earlier landmark was leading here.
